A single silent, low-volume, uncharged, or disconnected side is not by itself a battery diagnosis. The FOYCOY seller body says charging-contact oxidation can prevent charging or power-on and says an unpaired pair can leave only one earbud connected, with reset offered as a troubleshooting route. The wired Sennheiser IE 600 thread reports left and right one-side failures and contains disagreement over cable versus driver causes even though the product is not true wireless. These sources establish multiple symptom categories and the need for diagnosis, not the prevalence or root cause of any captured TWS listing.

Before checkout, verify the exact seller and SKU, new or renewed condition, refurbisher and prior battery history where applicable, current price, return window, warranty issuer and duration, regional service eligibility, firmware-update path, reset and re-pair procedure, contact-cleaning guidance, and whether individual earbuds, charging case, or battery service can be obtained and paired to the exact model. Record a same-volume, same-codec, same-feature baseline for single-charge runtime, left and right discharge, charging reliability, reconnects, and dropouts, then repeat under the same conditions across the return period and later checkpoints. For a defensible longevity ranking, obtain exact-model multi-unit or longitudinal evidence that reports usage hours, charge conditions, environment, failure definitions, censoring, replacement handling, and sample size rather than converting seller hours, ratings, or cross-model anecdotes into a failure rate.
